cc12497c6a5ad852698781bc631d4ab1.overview: In the mid-1960s, a group of high school friends who live on the Near North Side of Chicago enjoy life to the fullest...parties, hanging out, meeting new friends. Then life changes for two of the guys when they are falsely arrested in connection with stealing a Cadillac. We follow their lives through to the dramatic end of high school.
cc12497c6a5ad852698781bc631d4ab1.tagline: Where the Student Body Was a Chick Named Veronica... The Senior Prom was a 'belly rub' and the Class of '64 ran a Permanent crap game in the Men's Room!

cc813306c10ff11ac918f72107a84e4b.overview: A depressed man moves back in with his parents following a recent heartbreak and finds himself with two women.
cc813306c10ff11ac918f72107a84e4b.tagline: Sometimes we leave everything to find ourselves.

ccb002bc97d5e5d81e885c7d40285289.overview: Fictional documentary about the life of human chameleon Leonard Zelig, a man who becomes a celebrity in the 1920s due to his ability to look and act like whoever is around him. Clever editing places Zelig in real newsreel footage of Woodrow Wilson, Babe Ruth, and others.
ccb002bc97d5e5d81e885c7d40285289.tagline: You wanted more when it was all over!

ccd4023650d025f3444556d5a77b0bb0.overview: Eight visually rich vignettes drawn from Kurosawa’s own dreams—fox weddings and vanished orchards, a soldier’s ghosts, a walk through Van Gogh’s canvases, nuclear nightmares, and a water-mill utopia—meditate on childhood, art, mortality, and humanity’s uneasy bond with nature.
ccd4023650d025f3444556d5a77b0bb0.tagline: The past, present, and future. The thoughts and images of one man... for all men. One man's dreams... for every dreamer.

cce5a5e8e453215461181d19f2d91a8d.overview: A melancholy poet reflects on three women he loved and lost in the past: a mechanical performing doll, a Venetian courtesan, and the consumptive daughter of a celebrated composer.
cce5a5e8e453215461181d19f2d91a8d.tagline: You Will Never See Anything Finer On The Screen!
